title: Aquina Refluxed
description: A Power Generation Mod, Adding Siltstone stuff and Radioactive Stuff.
body:
# Whats This Mod Focused On?
This Mod Focuses On Reveloutionizing Tech In Minecraft.

Any Additional Mod Suggestions?
Yes, Jade helps with dealing with the tech. But only works server-side for tech help.

## Additions
**WATER FILTER GENERATOR, RADIATION RODS, RADIOACTIVE PROOF CASING AND GLASS, REFLUXING STATION, STEEL PLATE AND MOLTEN VARIENT, SOLIDIFIER, ENERGY BATTERY, ENERGY STORAGE UNIT, STRING FILTER**

**FUNCTIONALITY**
Water Filter Generator, well "generates" energy (FE) via water.

Radioactivity Generation, to generate with the stuff you need the casing, glass, and rods for it and it "needs redstone and generates FE".

Energy Battery, allows users to store power.

Solidifier, is only used to make steel plates for now.

Refluxing Station, has barely a functionality currently.
